description: A word counter, then punctuation, empty files and stdin
message: Implement count() in wordcount.py so `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes. It counts lowercase words and ignores punctuation.

steers.text: Words with punctuation should still count as words.
Add a test for empty files.
Read from stdin when no path is given.

probes.text: the scripted user turns are worked through and the workspace tests pass
